digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET code-review criterion
propositions: Explicit review-plan <bug> must escalate to the full blocking rubric when the ticket declares non-test file_impact, lifting the forced det_blocking=[] restriction at both precheck and route_criteria seams, while preserving the claim-time exemption and light advisory tier for small or test-only fixes.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug fixes with >150 non-test lines lacking a current-or-code-drifted cross-host attestation, verified via opcert_from_record and trusted-env keyrings with compute_validity freshness checks.

Attestation verification must read cross-host using opcert machinery (not own-env plan_review_status), accepting certified/stale-code/stale-head verdicts and flagging compute_validity plan-review-reachable literals plus op-cert failure verdicts while failing open (advisory only) on unavailable/error/unknown-future.
Non-test line classification must exclude tests/** and conftest.py via a single shared BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD constant imported by both the Gerrit criterion and backtest.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits with >150 non-test lines, producing zero mechanical false positives.
